diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only app1-related connectivity failures: app1 had eth1 configured as 10.10.50.10/32 and no default route, while other paths were healthy. Changed app1 eth1 to 10.10.50.10/24 and added default route via 10.10.50.1. Public success criteria then passed with all lab connectivity checks succeeding, including bidirectional reachability between app1 and user1/finance1.
diagnosis.reference: On app1, interface eth1 is configured with 10.10.50.10/32: the prefix length is wrong, it should be 10.10.50.10/24.
